name: Classify head

whatIsIt.eli5: Looks at the whole picture's notes and says which one word describes the picture best.
whatIsIt.simple: Turns the last backbone map into one score per class for the whole image: a 1×1 Conv to 1,280 channels, average over all positions, then a linear layer.
whatIsIt.engineer: Conv(c1, 1280) → AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1) → Flatten → Dropout → Linear(1280, nc); softmax at inference.

whyExists.eli5: Sometimes you only need to know what the picture shows, not where.
whyExists.simple: Classification does not need a neck or boxes; averaging over the map gives one description of the whole image.
whyExists.engineer: Global average pooling gives translation-invariant image descriptors with few parameters.

eli5: Average them over the whole picture.
simple: Average pooling makes one number per channel.
A linear layer gives one score per class.
engineer: Input 224×224 by default: the backbone map is 7×7.
No neck: the head reads the last backbone layer directly.

example.engineer: v8n-cls Classify: 1,611,240 params of 2.7 M total; output [1000].
